verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents an end-to-end automatable lifecycle. Its CLI covers searching for a GPU, renting it, waiting for boot, connecting, copying data and cleaning up, and it claims parity with the web console. A REST API with a live OpenAPI spec, a Python SDK (show_instances/start_instance), entrypoint override for workloads, scoped API keys for automation, and an official `vastai` agent skill let AI coding assistants drive it directly. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of monitoring/health-status APIs, independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven end-to-end runs, an MCP server (only an agent skill is evidenced), and API-driven initial account setup/credit top-up (the quickstart routes these through the console).
